program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 14.0, 22.0),     # diff-pair gm/Id (moderate/weak inversion)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # diff-pair L
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "L3":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "Itail": (7.6e-6, 6.0e-6, 8.2e-6),
    "Lt":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # tail / reference mirror L
    "gmidt": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    It = p["Itail"]
    Id = It / 2

    # reference diode and tail source (same L, same gm/Id -> ratio It/iref)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mr.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], It, vds=0.35)

    # PMOS mirror load (diode side vds = vsg)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Id, vds=0.7)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Id, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Id, vds=m3.vgs)

    # diff pair with source at tail node -> body effect
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id, vds=0.55, vsb=0.35)
    vtail = max(0.05, vcm - m1.vgs)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id,
                  vds=max(0.2, vdd - m3.vgs - vtail), vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(0.05, vcm - m1.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], It, vds=max(0.1, vtail))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> vinp is non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m4.gds
    A0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m4.cdd + m4.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    slew = It / cout
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.4 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    cmrr = 2 * m3.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-15) * gm1 / max(gm1, 1e-15)
    psrr = A0
    power = vdd * (iref + It)
    swing = (vdd - m4.vdsat - 0.05) - (vtail + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sn = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * kT * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(psrr),
        "power": power,
        "swing": swing,
        "noise_1k": sn * 3.0,
    }
